deploybot: Release paused for rollout 2026-03-20T15:40Z — config encryption metadata mismatch detected between staging and prod. Details: secret: inference-kms-config, field: encryption_algorithm.

alex: wait what mismatch? can someone paste the diff? :eyes:

sam-devex: pulling now. was seeing weird failures in canary during model load tests.

sam-devex: diff from staging -> prod (redacted):
```
staging: inference-kms-config:
  encryption_algorithm: AES-GCM
  kms_alias: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/rlm-key

prod: inference-kms-config:
  encryption_algorithm: AES256
  kms_alias: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/rlm-key-v1
```

alex: oh — different algorithm + alias. that explains decrypt errors in canary logs.

ops-oncall: seeing the same errors: "failed to unwrap DEK: unsupported algorithm AES256" in inference-runtime logs.

maria: this was the config change we rolled in last week for the dedicated rollout. release notes say kms alias migrated but looks like staging didn't get the alias rename?

sam-devex: staging has a newer alias but changed algorithm to AES-GCM when we started using HSM-backed keys. prod still on older AES256. deploybot's parity check flagged it during pre-promote.

rita-sre: recommend pause and either: 1) revert staging secret to AES256 + alias v1 for parity, or 2) patch prod to accept AES-GCM and new alias. Prod patch needs SRE + security review and might miss the change window.

alex: what is impact surface? only model payload decrypts, or other services?

ops-oncall: primarily inference-runtime and cache-writer. A few downstream consumers fail to initialize cache when decrypt fails, causing request 500s in canary.

maria: release manager here — we are in the middle of a customer-facing deploy window. If we rollback staging we lose the dedicated rollout progress. What's lowest risk?

rita-sre: lowest risk is revert staging secret to match prod, then re-run canary. It preserves prod and avoids emergency KMS changes.

sam-devex: agree. I can push a quick staging secret change. command I'll run: `kubectl -n inference set secret inference-kms-config --from-literal=encryption_algorithm=AES256 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`

alex: before you run, let's snapshot current staging secret and notify security. also add a migration ticket for aligning KMS alias across envs.

sam-devex: snapshot done and uploaded to `s3://redwood-infra/rotations/2158643210-staging-secret-snap.yaml` (access: infra-team). pinged @security.

deploybot: Noted — release remain paused. Rollout ID: r-2026-03-20-14.

ops-oncall: once staging matches, we'll re-run pre-promote parity check: `./tools/release-check --env prod --compare staging`

maria: adding to release notes: "hotfix: staging secret temporarily reverted to maintain parity with prod; dedicated rollout delayed pending KMS alias consolidation."

rita-sre: filing postmortem action items: align KMS alias naming convention, add KMS algorithm explicitness to release checklist, add automated KMS alias reconciliation in CI.

alex: timeline? sam, can you make the change in the next 10m?

sam-devex: doing it now. applying...

sam-devex: applied. restarting canary pods in staging: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime-canary`

ops-oncall: monitoring logs. so far no decrypt errors in staging after restart.

deploybot: Pre-promote parity check passed for secrets. Ready to resume rollout when release manager approves.

maria: approve resume. resuming now but will keep canary at 5% for another hour.

alex: good call keeping canary long. follow-up: schedule a short meeting with security and infra to plan the KMS alias consolidation.

maria: scheduled 2026-03-21 10:00 PT. invite sent.

rita-sre: filing a follow-up ticket: INF-5321 (KMS alias parity + algorithm checks in releasebot).

alex: thanks everyone. cc: @product to update downstream customers if needed. :thumbsup:

maria: will handle customer comms if any.

sam-devex: closing thread when rollout completes — will post final status.

deploybot: Rollout resumed at 2026-03-20T15:55Z — canary at 5%.
